LEX_UNKNOWN_CHARACTER.hint: Check for typos or unexpected symbols in your block.

LEX_UNTERMINATED_STRING.hint: Make sure your text string has a closing double quote (").

PARSE_TRAILING_INPUT.message: Extra text at the end of the line: '{extraText}'.
PARSE_TRAILING_INPUT.hint: Remove the extra text or check your formula.

PARSE_EXPECTED_IDENTIFIER.message: Expected a variable name, but found '{found}'.
PARSE_EXPECTED_IDENTIFIER.hint: Use a valid variable name starting with a letter.

PARSE_EXPECTED_EQUALS.hint: Use 'variable = expression' to set a value.

PROCESS_MISSING_EQUALS.message: A process block must save its answer into a variable.
PROCESS_MISSING_EQUALS.hint: Try adding a variable assignment, e.g. 'x = {src}'.

PROCESS_ASSIGN_TO_RESERVED.message: Cannot use reserved keyword '{name}' as a variable name.
PROCESS_ASSIGN_TO_RESERVED.hint: Choose a different variable name like 'my{name}' or 'total'.

UNKNOWN_VARIABLE.message: Variable '{name}' has not been created yet.
UNKNOWN_VARIABLE.hint: Did you mean '{suggestion}'? Make sure you assign it before reading.

DIVIDE_BY_ZERO.hint: Check that your divisor is not 0 before performing '{op}'.

TYPE_MISMATCH.hint: Make sure both sides have matching compatible types.

IF_NOT_BOOLEAN.message: If block condition must give a yes/no answer (true or false), but got {actualType}.
IF_NOT_BOOLEAN.hint: Use a comparison operator like '=', '<', or '>' inside your Decision block.

STEP_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.message: Program stopped after {budget} steps. It might be in an endless loop.

INPUT_NOT_A_NUMBER.hint: Please type a valid numeric value.

NO_START.message: Flowchart must have a Start block.
NO_START.hint: Drag a Start block onto the canvas to begin.

MULTIPLE_START.hint: Flowcharts can only have one Start block. Delete extra Start blocks.

NO_STOP.hint: Add a Stop block so your flowchart knows when to end.

DANGLING_OUTPUT.message: This {nodeKind} block is not connected to anything.
DANGLING_OUTPUT.hint: Drag an arrow from its bottom handle to the next block.

UNCONNECTED_BRANCH.message: The '{branch}' path of this Decision block is not connected.
UNCONNECTED_BRANCH.hint: Connect an arrow from the '{branch}' handle to another block.

UNREACHABLE_NODE.message: This {nodeKind} block cannot be reached from Start.
UNREACHABLE_NODE.hint: Connect an arrow leading into this block or remove it.

NO_REACHABLE_STOP.message: Flowchart has no path leading to a Stop block.
NO_REACHABLE_STOP.hint: Make sure at least one path reaches a Stop block.

VARIABLE_MAYBE_UNASSIGNED.message: Variable '{name}' might be used before it is given a value.
VARIABLE_MAYBE_UNASSIGNED.hint: Ensure '{name}' is set by an Input or Process block on all incoming paths.

MULTIPLE_OUTGOING_EDGES.message: This block has multiple arrows connected to the same output.
MULTIPLE_OUTGOING_EDGES.hint: A block can only have one outgoing arrow per handle.
